0.name: Actinic keratoses
0.description: Actinic keratoses: rough, scaly, hyperkeratotic patch on sun-damaged skin with erythematous base and dotted vessels — precancerous lesion on sun-exposed sites.

1.name: Basal cell carcinoma
1.description: Basal cell carcinoma: pearly translucent papule with arborizing vessels, leaf-like areas, blue-grey ovoid nests, and shiny white structures — locally invasive skin malignancy.

2.name: Benign keratosis
2.description: Benign keratosis: stuck-on seborrheic keratosis with cerebriform surface, milia-like cysts, comedo-like openings, and well-demarcated borders.

3.name: Dermatofibroma
3.description: Dermatofibroma: central white scar-like patch surrounded by delicate peripheral pigment network — firm benign dermal papule with positive dimple sign.

4.name: Melanoma
4.description: Melanoma: asymmetric lesion with atypical pigment network, blue-white veil, regression structures, irregular streaks, and multiple colours — malignant melanocytic tumour.

5.name: Melanocytic nevi
5.description: Melanocytic nevi: benign symmetric mole with regular pigment network, uniform brown-to-black colour, smooth borders, and homogeneous or globular pattern.

6.name: Vascular lesions
6.description: Vascular lesions: cherry angioma or pyogenic granuloma with red to purple lacunae, reddish homogeneous area, sharp borders, and no pigment network.
